verdict.rationale: AI-generated insights are a fair question for a terminal emulator, since some terminals ship built-in AI assistance, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Alacritty offering any AI analysis or suggestions. Its documented features are vi mode, search, regex hints, multi-window, IPC and configuration, and the docs and community both describe it as deliberately minimal.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
